checked_contracts: Externally pinned prior confirmed handoff binds same selected descriptor/profile, fetch bytes and each MAIN page compressed hash/length.
Each reused response authenticates compressed and decoded SHA256/length and traversed exact original Full cursor requests and header/predecessor chain.

Reuse ends at an actually fully consumed confirmed page; entire raw partial last page is dropped and refetched from previous complete-page cursor; no raw response truncation/projection or post-query-page promotion.

Fresh new fixed frontier must advance with same depth policy; original birth, seam and prior frontier get fresh exact header and selected-chain checks, with seam/frontier rechecked after current/post/repeat operations.
Fresh Full delta rejects removals and gaps via unchanged scan and must actually cover prior fixed frontier before new fixed frontier.
All merged prefix graph edges/locators and exact consumed row count are reconstructed; output remains FETCHED_PENDING_REPLAY and requires unchanged complete-prefix SDK/native replay.
Fresh exact all-input/current-head/payout queries, fresh post-query scan and final exact query repeat use unchanged acquisition functions; no old current view is reused.
Cache uncertainty, mismatch, missing data, stale frontier or scan error triggers original complete fetchOne acquisition in a separate fresh output subtree.
Collector provenance names and hashes new delta producer; it does not claim old fetch producer identity.
No signer, submit API, wallet/circuit/profile/rate change or acceptance shortcut is introduced.

controls.genuine_same_exit1_control: PENDING: complete unchanged SDK/native replay must reproduce exact original HISTORY and CHECKPOINT bytes before use for later confirmations.

fixed_during_review.fix: Track consumedGroups explicitly and retain only when equal to exact raw group count; author added trailing repeated-frontier regression.
fixed_during_review.problem: Comparing cursor to final raw hash did not establish that every raw group had been consumed; a repeated frontier in unconsumed trailing groups could falsely mark a partial page whole.

limits: Source correctness review only; no independent consensus proof, continuous currentness, broader privacy qualification or production-safety claim.
Every owner and replacement relay must still independently cold replay the complete joined prefix.
Host exclusion policy must guard source, SDK, selector, cache and retained-page metadata before collector public-content reads.
No original private contents, node RPC, proof jobs, transactions or broadcasts were used by this reviewer.
scope: Read-only incremental public raw Full RPC collector; no financial implementation or execution changes.

upstream_semantics_boundary.meaning: Reuse relies on deterministic per-accepting-block data while retained selected-chain membership remains valid. Strict blue-score depth greater than20 is a confirmation policy, not irrevocable finality. Remote deployed build/config remain unauthenticated.
